scope: Read-only research after the cross-window wall was identified. No Unreal operation, project modification or geometry placement was performed by this agent.
decision: No new photograph reliably locates the floor bands in model coordinates. Keep the material improvements; do not place black strips or extend the reflective-wall layout from the current evidence.

what_the_cross_anchor_resolves.room_identity: The user confirmed the photographed hall is this dining hall.
what_the_cross_anchor_resolves.vertical_limit: The raw user-view centre intersects the wall at h = 1.6733140446 m, below the dado. The built cross height h = 2.62 m is a disclosed photographic estimate following the visible above-dado relationship, not an independent height measurement.
what_the_cross_anchor_resolves.interpretation: This anchors wall identity, left/right orientation and one horizontal landmark. It does not register the original photograph's floor plane.

why_floor_band_placement_remains_unresol: The archived UE user camera is not the HK01 camera. Its pose and field of view cannot be substituted for the source photograph's camera calibration.

The two built windows are 1.5 m wide and 2.25 m high with photo-estimated spacing. These numbers are reconstruction choices, not surveyed rulers. Fitting the photograph to those windows would propagate those choices into apparently precise but unsupported floor coordinates.

The cross supplies one horizontal location on a vertical wall. Even a fitted homography on that wall does not transfer floor points on a different plane without additional camera or floor constraints.

The photographed columns and black strips have not been matched to independently confirmed floor positions. No measured distance, uniquely identified floor corner or band-to-door junction ties the visible strips to the user's plan.
Vanishing directions may suggest strip orientation, but they do not by themselves fix strip width, room depth offsets or all column positions at a defensible metric scale.

People, tables, column occlusion, muddy water and crop boundaries hide strip junctions and ends. The visible segments do not establish a complete regular grid, equal spacing, repetition count or perimeter border.
The model's room extent and ceiling height are estimated. They cannot be used as independent evidence to resolve the photographic scale.

bounded_observations_safe_to_retain.visible_relationship: Broad charcoal terrazzo bands cross portions of the pale field and connect around the visible column-base zone; at least two transverse portions and a connecting portion are visible.
bounded_observations_safe_to_retain.limits: This is image-local topology, not a solved model-coordinate graph. Some apparent connections and endpoints are obscured. No world-space points or strip widths are supplied.

bounded_observations_safe_to_retain.visible_relationship: A broad dark speckled strip crosses the foreground in front of the group and reaches the right visible column-base area.
bounded_observations_safe_to_retain.limits: People hide much of the strip. Matching this column to the 2023 view is not a calibrated multi-view reconstruction.

reflective_wall_limits: The user-confirmed right-hand direction identifies which side of the room the photographed reflective surface belongs toward; it does not identify both ends or the full extent of that surface.
The current evidence does not recover reliable panel widths, panel counts, door relationships or the positions of changes in finish along that wall.

Reflected windows, beams or furniture are virtual images. Their screen positions cannot be copied into room geometry as extra real objects or used as direct floor correspondences without a solved reflecting plane.
The wet floor photograph also reflects the room. Those floor reflections must not be mistaken for physical strips, openings or the normal dry floor's gloss.

new_source_search_result.candidate: Salesians of Don Bosco China Province newsletter, January-February 2021
new_source_search_result.web_text_status: Text was accessible through web browsing; visual access to the relevant pages was not successfully completed in this research turn.
new_source_search_result.provenance_problem: The ATS-headed pages also discuss visits to students' families and activities at Shau Kei Wan's Salesian seminary. A dining photograph on such a page cannot be assigned to the ATS dining hall from the page heading alone.
new_source_search_result.conclusion: No new registered floor panorama was obtained. Search stopped as requested; no access restriction was bypassed.

safe_current_work: Retain the parent agent's completed wall and dry-terrazzo material improvements, subject to its rendered verification.
Keep the light floor's distinct angular dark/grey/pale aggregate and stable average appearance at distance, without introducing a guessed geometric strip grid.
Use a dry low-to-moderate sheen; the 2023 flood water is not a reference for normal mirror gloss.
A separate dark speckled terrazzo material can be prepared for later confirmed strips, but material availability does not justify arbitrary placement.
not_proposed: No black-band world coordinates, widths, repeat interval or full-room grid
No inferred additional reflective panels or whole-wall mirror covering
No unmeasured slab-joint module or wear/scratch pattern
No duplicate change to materials already completed by the parent
minimal_evidence_that_would_change_the_d: An unobstructed view tying visible band junctions or column feet to the confirmed cross wall and a second independent floor landmark, plus one real measured distance or a dimensioned floor plan. A photo alone can support bounded estimates only if the corresponding floor controls and projection are actually recoverable.
completion_status: Research report complete. No UE execution or scene validation claimed.
